verdict.rationale: Canny documents its own changelog product for announcing shipped updates, and separately documents embedding a Canny widget into websites and mobile apps. Nothing in the evidence says that widget shows the changelog rather than only feedback boards, so in-product changelog embedding is implied rather than shown. missing for 10: explicit documentation of an embeddable changelog widget, in-app changelog install or configuration details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can showcase new updates within my product using an embeddable changelog widget

citations.quote: Announce what you shipped, show customers you heard them, and turn closed feedback into retention and upgrades.
